def periodic_rdf_and_coordination(
    positions: Array,
    box_length: float,
    bin_edges: Array,
    *,
    coordination_cutoff: float,
) -> tuple[Array, Array, Array, Array]:
    """Estimate an RDF and coordination from cubic periodic trajectory frames."""

    frame_count, atom_count, _ = positions.shape
    displacement = positions[:, :, None, :] - positions[:, None, :, :]
    displacement -= box_length * jnp.round(displacement / box_length)
    distance = jnp.linalg.norm(displacement, axis=-1)

    unordered_pair = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((atom_count, atom_count), dtype=bool), k=1)
    pair_distances = jnp.where(unordered_pair[None, :, :], distance, jnp.inf)
    counts, _ = jnp.histogram(pair_distances.reshape(-1), bins=bin_edges)

    radii = 0.5 * (bin_edges[:-1] + bin_edges[1:])
    shell_volumes = (4.0 * jnp.pi / 3.0) * (
        bin_edges[1:] ** 3 - bin_edges[:-1] ** 3
    )
    number_density = atom_count / box_length**3
    expected_counts = (
        0.5 * frame_count * atom_count * number_density * shell_volumes
    )
    supported = bin_edges[1:] <= 0.5 * box_length
    rdf = jnp.where(supported, counts / expected_counts, jnp.nan)

    inside_cutoff = supported & (bin_edges[1:] <= coordination_cutoff)
    coordination = number_density * jnp.sum(
        jnp.where(inside_cutoff, rdf * shell_volumes, 0.0)
    )
    return radii, rdf, supported, coordination


fcc = argon_fcc(2, 0.0275)
box_length = float(fcc.cell.lengths()[0])
radii, rdf, supported, coordination = periodic_rdf_and_coordination(
    jnp.asarray(fcc.positions)[None, :, :],
    box_length,
    jnp.arange(0.0, 8.08, 0.08),
    coordination_cutoff=5.12,
)
peak = int(jnp.nanargmax(rdf))
print(f"atoms={len(fcc)}, box length={box_length:.2f} Å")
print(f"first RDF peak={float(radii[peak]):.2f} Å")
print(f"coordination through 5.12 Å={float(coordination):.1f}")
print(f"last supported bin center={float(radii[supported][-1]):.2f} Å")
